Williams sisters lose U.S. Open doubles comeback match

Tennis stars Serena and Venus Williams lost their U.S. Open doubles comeback match in the first round. They were defeated by Australian Maya Joint and her partner Hao-Ching Chan. The match went to a three-set thriller, with the Williams sisters losing in a match tiebreaker. Despite leading the deciding tiebreak 5-0, they ultimately lost 3-6, 7-6 (8-6), 7-6 (10-7). Their return to the U.S. Open was described as an emotional doubles return.
